hypothesis: BTC trends and volatility clusters can support a small set of structurally distinct H1/H4/D1 mechanisms whose edge survives directional separation, temporal regimes, Ostium costs and risk-based sizing for 200 USDC.
research_proxy: BTCUSDT Binance spot official monthly klines

data_contract.bar_alignment: UTC epoch boundaries; label and execute at bar open
data_contract.proxy_limitation: Research only until BTCUSDT/BTCUSD Ostium OHLC and execution parity pass

data_quality_exclusions.2017: Excluded before performance inspection: official archive contains exchange-outage placeholders offset from UTC minute boundaries (for example 2017-12-04), and normalizing them would create duplicates or synthetic bars.
data_quality_exclusions.2018-01_to_2018-02: Excluded before performance inspection after February was found to contain 1,201 actively traded bars shifted 34.789 seconds from UTC minute boundaries; rounding would alter event order.

cost_model.limitation: Historical Ostium dynamic impact and rollover are unavailable; conservative/stress values are preregistered falsifiers, not measurements.

execution_contract.entry: next bar open with adverse spread/impact
execution_contract.intrabar_stop: gap-adverse stop fill; no optimistic target priority
execution_contract.position_policy: one position per candidate; signals while open ignored
execution_contract.liquidation_model: Ostium 25% backstop formula plus adverse price path

fixed_mechanism_contracts.donchian_trend: Close breaks the prior N-bar channel; enter next open; exit next open after opposite exit-channel close or ATR catastrophe stop.
fixed_mechanism_contracts.trend_pullback: Close is on trend side of EMA and Wilder RSI reaches registered extreme; enter next open; exit at close after registered bars or ATR stop.
fixed_mechanism_contracts.compression_breakout: ATR rank was below the registered quantile in one of the prior three completed bars and close breaks the prior channel; enter next open; exit after registered bars or ATR stop.

selection.rule: graph medoid of each stable connected component without performance metrics

sqcli_policy: Do not run Builder/Optimizer unless a stable component passes independent validation and small-account economics.
